definitions: A shrub, Veronica stricta, endemic to New Zealand.
A shrub, Veronica salicifolia, endemic to New Zealand.

blocks.text: Veronica salicifolia, synonym Hebe salicifolia, the koromiko, or willow-leaf hebe, is a flowering plant in the family Plantaginaceae, which is found throughout the South Island of New Zealand and in Chile. It is a large, evergreen shrub, reaching two metres in height, with light-green, spear-shaped leaves that are up to twelve centimetres (4.7 in) long, and white or pale lilac flowers.
Veronica stricta, synonym Hebe stricta, commonly called koromiko, is a flowering plant in the family Plantaginaceae, which is endemic to New Zealand.

images.alt: New Zealand moth S. rotuella, known to pollinate V. salicifolia
